crossRefs.note: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.
Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?
“Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.
So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”
For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.
For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak…
Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?
it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order…
But Felix, having more exact knowledge concerning the Way, deferred them, saying, “When Lysias, the commanding officer…
Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.
Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may…
Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in…
that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.
My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.
Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,
To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?

translations.web: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.
translations.bsb: For truly my words are free of falsehood; one perfect in knowledge is with you.
translations.kjv: For truly my words shall not be false: he that is perfect in knowledge
translations.asv: For truly my words are not false: One that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.
